:::{#exm-cident}
#### A shared regression model

Suppose each $Y_i$ is binary,
with $\Pr(Y_i = 1 \mid X_i = x) = \prob(x)$ for one function $\prob$ shared by every $i$
(for instance, $\prob(x) = x / (1 + x)$ for a dose $x \ge 0$).
Then $\dsn{Y}$ are conditionally identically distributed given $\Xin$,
with $G(y \mid x) = 1 - \prob(x)$ for $y \in [0, 1)$
(and $0$ for $y < 0$, $1$ for $y \ge 1$).
Their marginal distributions can still differ:
if participant 1 always receives dose $0$ and participant 2 always receives dose $1$,
then $\Pr(Y_1 = 1) = 0$ but $\Pr(Y_2 = 1) = 1/2$.

:::
